description: Test suite for WhatsApp inbound message helper functions, including text extraction, contact parsing, location handling, and media placeholder generation.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts the main text content from various WhatsApp message formats, including contact cards, captions, and conversation bodies.

methods.name: extractMediaPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns placeholder text for media messages based on the message type.

methods.name: extractLocationData
methods.description: Extracts location information from message objects, including coordinates, place name, and additional metadata.
